prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Close-up portrait of a person with pale skin, focusing on the lower half of their face. The subject’s lips are painted with bold, matte black lipstick, creating a striking contrast against their skin. Their mouth is open, and their tongue is extended outward, displaying a bright yellow lightning bolt-shaped object resting on the center of the tongue. The person has a silver septum piercing, adding an edgy, modern touch to their appearance. The background is softly blurred and neutral, ensuring all attention remains on the face and the vivid yellow lightning bolt. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the texture of the lips and tongue while maintaining a clean, high-fashion editorial style. The overall composition is symmetrical and tightly framed, emphasizing the dramatic, rebellious mood and the pop-art color palette.
